newsitem.title: USA: Hanover Direct says receives $30 mln advance.
newsitem.headline: Hanover Direct says receives $30 mln advance.

text.p: Hanover Direct Inc said on Thursday it had received an advance of $30 million from Richemont Finance SA, an affiliate of the company's majority shareholder, to facilitate vendor shipments and to begin the company's plan to consolidate some of its warehousing facilities.

The advance was made in conjunction with the company's previously announced shareholder rights offering, Hanover Direct said. It added that Richemont had agreed to purchase all shares not subscribed for by Hanover's shareholders.

The company currently expects to issue the rights on April 29, it said, entitling holders to purchase additional shares of common stock at $0.90 per share. The record date for the rights offering is expected to be April 28 and the expiration date is expected to be May 30, it said.
Hanover Direct is a direct specialty retailer that markets home fashions and general merchandise.
Richemont is a Swiss-based group with interests in subsidiary companies primarily in the fields of luxury goods and tobacco.
